newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba - No comment on Kyodo intervention plan report.
newsitem.headline: Buba - No comment on Kyodo intervention plan report.

text.p: Germany's Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it would not comment on reports that Japan, the US and Germany are exploring the possibility of joint intervention in foreign exchange markets.
"We do not comment on rumours," a Bundesbank spokeswoman told Reuters. "The Bundesbank stands by the statement made at the G7."
Last week, Group of Seven (G7) leaders meeting in Washington said that they would cooperate to prevent a further rise in the dollar.

Earlier on Wednesday, the Japanese news agency Kyodo quoted an international monetary source as saying that Japan, the U.S. and Germany were exploring the possibility of joint intervention in forex markets to sell dollars for yen.
